status: declared before any model score; owner (20 Nov): 'Continue' (item 2 of the fixable-parts list, malaria)
question: Does the model's malaria suitability (Mordecai 2013 thermal response x a monthly rain gate, annual mean) match where malaria pressed on people over millennia, and does a different rain gate match better?

targets.primary: Sickle haemoglobin (HbS) allele frequency, Piel et al. 2013 (Malaria Atlas Project raster Explorer__2013_Sickle_Haemoglobin_HbS_Allele_Freq_Global_5k), a population-genetic footprint of historical P. falciparum pressure (Piel et al. 2010 Nat Commun)
targets.secondary: G6PD deficiency allele frequency, Howes et al. 2012 (Explorer__2012_G6PDd_Allele_Frequency_Global_5k); mapped only within 2010 malaria-endemic countries, so it scores only where defined
targets.download: MAP GeoServer WCS GetCoverage, subset 0-56 N, 12 W - 125 E, 2.5 arc-min, 2026-11-20, data/cache/map_genetics; not redistributed
targets.caveat: allele frequencies also carry population history (migration, drift) and are interpolated from surveys; they rank long-run pressure, not AD 200 prevalence

domain: Earth run window (0-56 N, 12 W - 125 E); 1-degree blocks with >= 50 % land and >= 50 % valid target cells
split: 10-degree tiles in a checkerboard: dev = (floor(lat/10) + floor(lon/10)) even, blind = odd

models.M0: current: mean over months of thermal(T) x max(smoothstep(P, 0, 80 mm), 0.75 x irrigation)
models.variants: rain-gate top P1 in {20, 40, 80, 120, 160, 240} mm/month, plus no gate (thermal only); summary = annual mean (as now) or the share of months >= 0.25 (the map's season threshold); 14 variants including M0
models.inputs: WorldClim 2.1 monthly T and P at 5 arc-min (the Earth run's source), Earth run irrigation field
models.choice: variant with the highest dev Spearman against HbS

scores: Spearman of 1-degree block means, model vs target; also reported within Africa and outside Africa

blind_gates.V: component validation: M0 blind Spearman vs HbS >= 0.30 -> malaria pattern supported
blind_gates.G1: chosen variant blind Spearman vs HbS >= M0 + 0.05
blind_gates.G2: chosen variant blind Spearman vs G6PD >= M0 - 0.02
blind_gates.adopt: G1 and G2: the map's malaria field uses the chosen gate (feeds health, livability, population; a rebuild is planned with the owner first). Otherwise M0 stays; V is reported either way. The population penalty (0.35) is NOT tested here.

amendment_1.when: after the dev run, before the blind run; scores unchanged
amendment_1.change: The undeclared code control compared M0 with the Earth run's stored 'malaria', which is the older MARA index (land_people.malaria), not the map's Mordecai-based field; it showed max diff 0.76. The control now compares M0 with harvest.models.malaria_fields on the same inputs: max diff 3e-16. Note: the Earth population runs (polity.earth.earth_people) still use the MARA index while the map uses Mordecai; reported, not changed.
